name: Push-Up Test

name: Wall Sit Test
description: Hold a seated position against a wall.

name: 1RM Squat
description: Find the maximum weight lifted for one squat repetition.

name: Pull-Up Test
description: Perform as many pull-ups as possible using an overhand grip.

name: Flexed Arm Hang
description: Hold the chin above the pull-up bar for as long as possible.

name: Single-Leg Squat Test

name: Hollow Hold Test
description: Hold a hollow-body position on the floor to assess core strength and stability.

name: Side Plank Hold
description: Hold a side plank position as long as possible to assess lateral core endurance.

name: Curl-Up Test
description: Perform controlled curl-ups continuously to assess abdominal endurance.

name: Sit-Up Test
description: Perform as many sit-ups as possible to assess core endurance.

name: Plank Hold
description: Maintain a plank position for as long as possible.

name: Burpee Test
description: Perform as many burpees as possible within a set time.

name: Cooper 12-Min Run
description: Cover the greatest distance possible in 12 minutes.

name: Yo-Yo Test

name: Shuttle Run Test

name: Rockport Walk Test

name: 600m Run

name: 1 km Run
description: Complete 1 kilometer in the shortest possible time.

name: 1.5 km Run
description: Complete 1.5 kilometers in the shortest possible time.

name: Beep Test
description: Run 20m shuttles at increasing speeds until exhaustion.

name: 5m Sprint

name: 10m Sprint

name: 20m Sprint

name: 30m Sprint

name: 100 m Sprint

name: Ladder Drill Test

name: Ball Chase Test

name: SEMO Agility Test

name: Zig-Zag Run

name: Squat Jump

name: Single-Leg Hop Test

name: Standing Broad Jump

name: Triple Hop Test
description: Perform three consecutive hops for maximum distance.

name: Medicine Ball Throw
description: Throw a medicine ball as far as possible to assess upper-body power.

name: Toe Touch Test

name: Shoulder Flexibility Test

name: Back Scratch Test

name: Butterfly Stretch Test

name: Groin Flexibility Test
description: Assess flexibility of the hip adductors and groin muscles.

name: Knee-to-Wall Test

name: Trunk Flexion Test

name: Y-Balance Test

name: Star Excursion Test

name: Single-Leg Hop & Hold

name: Stork Stand Test

name: Flamingo Balance Test

name: Single-Leg Stand

name: Eyes Closed Balance Test

name: Slalom Dribble Test

name: Target Throw Test

name: Football Juggling Test

name: Dribbling Test
description: Dribble a ball through a course while maintaining control.

name: Ruler Drop Test

name: Choice Ball Catch Test
